featured_reviews.name: Abhishek More
featured_reviews.review_text:
3.5-Star Review

Seat covers, a steering wrap, floor lamination, and a window chrome kit were purchased for the Ertiga.

The leather quality of the seat covers is good, and the fitting is also done nicely, giving the interior a clean look. However, one issue noticed is with the second-row seats — the seat cover completely blocks the seat lever, and there is no proper provision or cut-out to access it. This makes it inconvenient to use.

Since multiple items were purchased (seat covers, floor lamination, steering wrap, and chrome kit), there was no bargaining on the price. Instead, only a small complimentary perfume was requested.

Additionally, when inquiries were made about other accessories, the pricing quoted was higher than the market rate. For example, a room LED light that is easily available in the market for ₹50 was quoted as ₹70, and then it was said, “for you, it will be ₹60.” On top of that, ₹50 was asked for installation, even though it is a simple DIY product. Therefore, it was not installed there.

Earlier, a 5-star rating was given because of insistence to rate the service 5 stars. However, after noticing these issues, a more honest rating felt appropriate at 3.5 stars.

Overall, the seat cover quality and fitting are good, but pricing transparency and attention to small practical details could be improved.

featured_reviews.name: SugarDoctor Medicare Colaba
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am delighted to share my experience with Akbar Motors, Colaba, and especially Hussain and his outstanding team. Over the years, they have taken meticulous care of my cars, consistently exceeding expectations in resolving mechanical, hardware, and even complex software issues. Their expertise in handling German and Italian luxury cars is truly impressive, and you’ll often find a lineup of high-end vehicles in their workshop a testament to their trustworthiness and skill.

Hussain’s honesty and reasonable pricing set him apart in a field where such qualities are rare. His dedication mirrors the commitment I know as a doctor addressing every issue with precision and care. He doesn’t just fix problems; he ensures they don’t recur, which is invaluable.

I must also mention that Dr. Vineet Garg MD from Ajmer, who introduced me to Hussain, sends his Mercedes ML Class, E Class, and A Class cars to Akbar Motors for service and maintenance. This level of trust and consistency is incredible and speaks volumes about their expertise.

For anyone looking for reliable, expert, and fair service for luxury cars, **Akbar Motors** is the place to go. I wholeheartedly recommend them.

— Dr. Suresh Purohit

featured_reviews.name: keenan Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an audio upgrade needed for my vehicle ans was searching for someone that understands audio vs someone that would just screw the speakers on.

Rahul & Sachin were great to lend insights towards what might work best in my case. No one trying to selling you anything you don’t need, purely recommending the best configuration based on your requirement and ability to pay for. This is a highly recommended place for someone that cares about the quality of their audio experience in a vehicle or home.

Audio damping + wiring of my new components & amp was done in great time and had a completely hassle free experience, best to call the shop before going so you have an idea of the timeline and availability of the team

featured_reviews.review_text: I have had TWO of my previous cars (Maruti 800 DX and Mahindra Xylo) outfitted at Rhyme & Rhythm on the past and have had EXCELLENT experience. The owners, Rahul and Sachin are very courteous, knowledgeable and helpful. The centre is well equipped with a variety of options for all aspects of automobiles.
